actions.rss_find_site_feeds.description: Finds the RSS and Atom feeds a website publishes.
actions.rss_find_site_feeds.props.site_u: A page on the site, such as its homepage or a blog post.
actions.rss_read_feed.description: Gets a feed's details and its latest items, newest first.
actions.rss_read_feed.props.keyword.desc: Only return items whose title, summary or content contains this text (case-insensitive).
actions.rss_read_feed.props.limit.descri: Maximum number of items to return, newest first (1–100). Defaults to 20.
actions.rss_read_feed.props.published_af: Only return items published after this date and time. Items without a publish date are left out.
actions.rss_read_feed.props.rss_feed_url: Link to the feed itself, not the site homepage; Atom works too.
actions.rss_read_multiple_feeds.descript: Gets the latest items from several feeds as one list, newest first.
actions.rss_read_multiple_feeds.props.ke: Only return items whose title, summary or content contains this text (case-insensitive).
actions.rss_read_multiple_feeds.props.li: Maximum number of items to return, newest first (1–100). Defaults to 20.
actions.rss_read_multiple_feeds.props.pu: Only return items published after this date and time. Items without a publish date are left out.
actions.rss_read_multiple_feeds.props.rs: One feed address per row; a feed that fails to load is skipped.
triggers.new-item-list.description: Runs when a new item is published in any of the feeds you list.
triggers.new-item-list.props.rss_feed_ur: One feed address per row; a feed that fails to load is skipped.
triggers.new-item.description: Runs when a new item is published in an RSS feed.
triggers.new-item.props.rss_feed_url.des: Link to the feed itself, not the site homepage; Atom works too.
